title: Isolated rain till Nov 27, then a cold spell

slides.head: Isolated rain till Nov 27, then a cold spell
What happened
slides.body: Southern and central Telangana, including Hyderabad, could see isolated rain from November 25 to 27.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: IMD says partly cloudy skies and hazy morning conditions will persist due to the rain effect.

slides.head: Cold spell begins
slides.body: Hyderabad's low was 22.5°C, while Asifabad dipped to 15.6°C; a cold spell is forecast from Nov 29.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: IMD predicts light to moderate rain for two days, then dry weather.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: IMD minimum temperature readings from November 29. Ask: How cold could nights get during the Nov 29-Dec 4 spell?
